definitions.explanation: Causing feelings of enjoyment and satisfaction; making one feel happy.

examples.japanese: {愉快|ゆかい}な{仲間|なかま}と{過|す}ごす{時間|じかん}は{楽|たの}しい。
examples.english: Time spent with cheerful companions is enjoyable.

examples.japanese: {愉快|ゆかい}な{話|はなし}を{聞|き}いて{笑|わら}った。
examples.english: I laughed hearing an amusing story.

examples.japanese: あまり{愉快|ゆかい}な{気分|きぶん}ではない。
examples.english: I'm not in a very pleasant mood.
examples.notes: Often used in negative: 愉快ではない = not pleasant

notes:
USAGE: {愉快|ゆかい} describes something that brings joy or amusement. It's often used to describe people, stories, or situations.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{愉快|ゆかい}な{人|ひと} (pleasant/cheerful person)
・{愉快|ゆかい}な{気分|きぶん} (pleasant mood)
・{愉快|ゆかい}ではない (not pleasant, annoying)
・{不愉快|ふゆかい} (unpleasant, disagreeable)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{楽|たの}しい - fun, enjoyable (more casual)
・{愉快|ゆかい} - pleasant, amusing (slightly formal)
